Scholastic Chess Tournament

When: Sunday, October 25, 2026 at 12:45 PM ADT
UTC start: 2026-10-25T15:45:00.000Z
Location: Birchwood Intermediate School
Address: 49 Longworth Ave
Organizer: PEI Youth Chess Association
Facebook responses: 1 going, 9 interested, 10 responded
Description:
Sunday October 25 from 12:45-4 pm at Birchwood Intermediate School, 49 Longworth Ave., Charlottetown. Doors open at 12:30 pm.
Open to all students grade K - 12
Players are divided into groups by age and rating.
Everyone plays at least 4 games.
Medals for top 3 players in each section
Rated Chess’n Math Association Event
Entry fee for pre-registered players: $15 second player same family $10
Players should pre-register by e-mail prior to 6 pm on Saturday, October 24 by writing to: peiyouthchess@gmail.com
Please include the player’s full name, school, and grade.
The $15 entry fee for pre-registered players can be paid by e-transfer before 6 pm on Saturday to the same email address or by cash at the tournament before 12:45 pm.
Players who have not pre-registered may still sign up at the event before 12:45 pm. But the entry fee is $25 and there is no guarantee that they will be placed in an appropriate group based on their age and rating, though we will do our best in this regard.
All players must check in at the tournament before 12:45. Doors open at 12:30.
If you cannot attend after pre-registering, please notify us as soon as possible. Thanks!
This event qualifies you to play in the PEI Provincial tournament in April. All participants in the PEI Provincial tournament must have played in at least one PEIYCA tournament this year. Only PEIYCA tournaments are qualifying tournaments.
